title: Measure narrowband acquisition and drift
description:
Measure acquisition, carrier-offset tolerance, long-packet drift, PER and operation deadlines for the approved narrowband profile. Reuse rf.07/rf.08 calibration and timing work, adding only the narrowband-specific sweeps and packet durations. Include asymmetric endpoints and predeclared failure cases.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Before any port or RF action, require affirmative matching authority.10/rf.03 session approvals plus narrow.06/narrow.08 scope approval. Earlier session clearance or closed gates are not permission for new settings. Denied, expired or mismatched clearance leaves execution blocked or deferred.
acceptance_criteria: Known transmitted payloads, calibrated signal levels/frequency offsets and external timestamps establish results against narrow.03 bounds. Record exact build, setup, uncertainty, CPU/memory observations and failures. No nominal TCXO or bandwidth claim substitutes for these measurements.
